name: SSL 4000 E Channel EQ (82E242)
description: Solid State Logic 82E242 'Equaliser Filters' card (the black-knob E EQ), drawing T82242.70, ASSY REV 5, with the Nov 85 ECO values. Filters first, as the 611 mother board routes them: input -> RV5 / R56 -> HPF (C34 220n into R55 + gang c, T11 buffer, then a T12 Sallen-Key with C36 / C37 220n, R59 / R60 1K8 + gangs a / b, gain set by R58 7K5 over R57 + RV6): 18 dB/oct on the 47K A/log triple -> S4 -> LPF (unity Sallen-Key T13, 680R + 10K LIN gangs, C43 68n / C44 3n3) -> S1 -> EQ: two inverting summing amplifiers (T3 with the HF and HMF bands, T8 with the LMF and LF bands); each band's 25K LIN centre-tapped boost/cut pot sits between the section's input (1K0) and its output (1K0), its wiper drives the band's filter, and the band output returns to the summing node through 4K75; each wiper also has 1K8 to 0 V and 12K to the other band's output of the same section, as drawn. HF / LF: first-order shelf stages (T1 / T9) whose J112 switch closes a positive-feedback loop through 100 uF (the bell) and a second J112 that changes T2 / T10's gain; HMF / LMF: T4 / T6 band-pass with the Q pot's first gang in the + divider and its second gang in T5 / T7's gain. 13 x NE5534 on +-18 V (R77 / R78 22R, C48 / C49 10u, 26 x 10n). Trimmers RV1-RV6 set by SSL's ECO procedure (see the notes).

sources.title: Solid State Logic, 'EQUALISER FILTERS', drawing T82242.70 (card 82E242), ASSY REV 5, revision table to Rev 4 Jan 86; archive.org scan (4860 x 3271, 294 ppi) in the item 'SSL 4000/6000 Individual Cards', file '82E242 Equalizer Filters.pdf' p.4; p.3 is a Rev 3 scan (3300 x 2332)
K&A Electronics, ssl_82E242.pdf: the same drawing, ASSY REV 5, independent 100 dpi scan (value cross-check)

SSL fax 15 Nov 1985 (Trevor S), 'The 82E242 Rev. 4': published band specification (HF +-15 dB shelf / +-18 dB bell, 1.5-20 kHz, Q 1.0; HMF 600 Hz-10 kHz, LMF 160 Hz-2.2 kHz, Q 0.5-4.5, +-15 dB at lowest Q / +-18 dB at highest; LF 40-450 Hz, Q 1.7), the component changes (R6/R44 5K1, R7/R45 2K4, R81 33K, R87 7K5, R69/R71 680R, RV1/RV4 10K) and the trimmer set-up
82E242 edge-connector list (T82002.50, 611G mother board): every pot's ACW / CW / wiper pin; same archive.org file p.1

NE5534_22P.note: NE5534N (drawing note 1: all ICs 5534N) with Cc = 22 pF on pins 5-8: AVD 100 V/mV, unity-gain bandwidth 10 MHz, slew 6 V/us (TI datasheet, Cc = 22 pF); output swing about 1.5 V from each +-18 V rail. The comp cap is carried by gbw/slew

NE5534_10P.note: NE5534N with Cc = 10 pF (T2, T3, T8, T10, T12): between the datasheet's Cc = 0 (13 V/us) and 22 pF (6 V/us) figures; gbw 14 MHz, slew 9 V/us are interpolated (approximate). Inaudible at these closed-loop gains

J112.note: J112 N-channel switch JFET (drawing). Approximate, datasheet-centred: VGS(off) -1 to -5 V, rDS(on) <= 50 ohm (here 40 ohm), IDSS >= 5 mA; Ciss/Crss about 7 pF. Used only fully on (gate forward-biased through 10M) or pinched off (gate at about -18 V)

ZENER_3V3.note: D1 3V3 zener (type not marked): BV 3.3 V at 5 mA, generic. It only loads the +18 V rail (6.4 mA through R92)

controls.label: LF Bell

controls.label: HP Freq
controls.note: LF filter 47K A/log triple: the three 18 dB/oct poles (C34, C36, C37 220 nF with 1K8 + gang each)

controls.label: LP Freq
controls.note: HF filter 10K LIN dual: the 12 dB/oct Sallen-Key (C43 68n, C44 3n3, 680R + gang each); CW = lower

controls.label: HP In
controls.note: S4 on the LF filter shaft (the knob's ACW click). Default out

controls.label: LP In
controls.note: S1 on the HF filter shaft. Default out

controls.label: Mode
controls.note: E/G flavour switch of the behavioural model; this netlist is the E card 82E242 only. Stored only

controls.label: Output
controls.note: The 82E242 card has no output level control (T8 is unity, R54 10R to pin 43). Stored only

controls.label: On/Off
controls.note: The 611E EQ IN switch (on the switch card, not this card) is the host's unit bypass. Stored only

parts.note: Solver partition (cuts: fo, loads C22; circuit_cli autocut, docs/CIRCUIT_ENGINE.md section 10.27): the filter section's output node (0.1 ohm, an op-amp output through S1in/S1out) drives only this coupling cap into the 100k EQ input, so C22 sees it one sample late. 25+19-port groups become 19+19+6; -10.6 % instructions on a DI, null against the uncut netlist -115.7 dB rms on the DI (worst switch position -74.3 dB, HPF in), every ssleq case within +0.001 pp, aliasing -104.6 -> -104.3 dB.
